author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Original: round oval bubble (about 6:5) with a lower-left tail and two LEFT-aligned text lines, long over short. Rejected drawing: flatter wide oval on HRECT_L and the two lines centred/staggered, so it no longer matched the logo.
change: Rebuilt on SQUARE as a rounder oval (rx18/ry15) with the reference tail angle; both text lines share the left edge x=17 (long 17-31, short 17-26).
visual_review: Compared with the original and checked 48px light and dark previews; bubble curve is smooth, tail joins with round joins, lines read as text.
